STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_07974_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_07974_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_07974(data_out, empty, full, data_in, push, pop, reset, clk);

	parameter DEPTH = 8;			
	parameter WIDTH = 8;

	output [WIDTH-1:0] data_out;
	output empty;
	output full;

	input [WIDTH-1:0] data_in;
	input push;
	input pop;
	input reset;
	input clk;

	reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_out;		
	reg empty, full;					
	reg [DEPTH-1:0] wraddr, rdaddr;
	reg [WIDTH-1:0] reg_file [DEPTH-1:0];
	reg [DEPTH-1:0] num_elems;

	initial begin
		data_out = 8'd0;
		empty = 1'b1;
		full = 1'b0;
		wraddr = 8'd0;
		rdaddr = 8'd0;
		num_elems = 8'd0;
	end

	always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
		if (reset) begin
			data_out <= 8'd0;
			empty <= 1'b1;
			full <= 1'b0;
			wraddr <= 8'd0;
			rdaddr <= 8'd0;
			num_elems <= 8'd0;
		end else begin
			if (push && (~full) && (~pop)) begin
				reg_file[wraddr] <= data_in;
				wraddr <= (wraddr + 1) % DEPTH;
				num_elems <= num_elems + 1;
				
				if (empty)
					empty <= 1'b0;

				if ((wraddr == rdaddr) && (~empty) && (num_elems == DEPTH))
					full <= 1'b1;
				else
					full <= 1'b0;
			end else if (pop && (~empty) && (~push)) begin
				data_out <= reg_file[rdaddr];
				rdaddr <= (rdaddr + 1) % DEPTH;
				num_elems <= num_elems - 1;
				
				if (full)
					full <= 1'b0;

				if (wraddr == rdaddr)
					empty <= 1'b1;
				else
					empty <= 1'b0;
			end
		end
	end
	
endmodule
